prompt: Which statements about AOF rewrite are correct?
explanation: BGREWRITEAOF generates a minimal command sequence that reproduces the current dataset, so repeated overwrites and expired keys vanish from the log; the work happens in a background child while the parent keeps serving writes. Redis never blocks write commands for the whole rewrite.

options.text: The rewrite produces a minimal command sequence reproducing the current dataset
The rewrite runs in a background child process while writes continue
Write commands are blocked until the rewrite completes
The rewrite can shrink the file even when no key has ever expired
